message:
`createUser` now accepts an optional `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it, or `null` when it wasn't set. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the two in `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

- **`src/api/users.js`:** `createUser` stores the nickname (as `null` if omitted), and `getUser` includes `nickname` in what it returns.
- **`migrations/003_add_nickname.js` (new):** this adds the `nickname` column to `users`. The in-memory DB rejects inserts into unknown columns, so the column had to exist.

I left migrations 001 and 002 alone because they're already applied in production. `migrations/README.md` says the DBA team owns that folder, so they should review the new file before it ships.
